display.formula: x = anchor_x + distance_m * sin(bearing_deg); y = anchor_y + distance_m * cos(bearing_deg)
display.note: Starwild has no in-game coordinates or compass. Each world has its own display plane in meters. North is derived per world from the motion of the sun or the star. Until that derivation is recorded, north_derived is false and real bearings stay null. The compass rose calibration lives in data/compass.json and stays uncalibrated until a north offset is measured. The origin anchor is (0, 0). Eden's origin is Talon's Public Outpost. Places logged from the previous origin stay reanchor_pending, with no stored position, until offset_from_previous_m is measured and those positions are updated. Other points use a bearing and a distance from an anchor. x and y are optional explicit meters; when they are null, the map computes the display position. z is not plotted.
